Container.Name: botsu
Container.Overview: Lean self-hosted chat bot for Discord and Fluxer: YouTube upload/live and Twitch live alerts, moderation (cases, warnings, temp-bans, mod log), server tools and music (YouTube via yt-dlp). Replaces Red-DiscordBot without Java/Lavalink. Fill in the fields below (at least the Discord or Fluxer token), or leave them blank and use the settings file the container creates at /mnt/user/appdata/botsu/botsu.env; fields win over the file. No ports are needed.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and the settings file botsu.env (created on first start: put your tokens there).

Config.Name: Discord token
Config.Description: Bot token from the Discord developer portal (Bot → Reset Token). Needs Message Content Intent turned on. Set this and/or the Fluxer token.

Config.Name: Fluxer token
Config.Description: Bot token from your Fluxer instance (Settings → Developer → your application). Set this and/or the Discord token.

Config.Name: Fluxer address
Config.Description: Web address of a self-hosted Fluxer instance, for example https://fluxer.example.com. Leave blank for fluxer.app.

Config.Name: Command prefix
Config.Description: Prefix for commands. Blank = $ (as Red used). Use something else, for example !, while another bot uses $ on the same servers.

Config.Name: Bot owners
Config.Description: User IDs of the bot's owners: they outrank everyone on every server and alone may run tube/twitch import, tube shorts and music test/where/update. Comma-separated; Discord and Fluxer IDs can be mixed. Run !tube import and the bot replies with your ID.

Config.Name: YouTube API key
Config.Description: YouTube Data API v3 key (recommended): @handles and live-stream detection. Without it, YouTube alerts work with channel links/IDs only.

Config.Name: Twitch client ID
Config.Description: From dev.twitch.tv/console/apps. Set both Twitch fields to enable Twitch alerts.

Config.Name: Fluxer API URL
Config.Description: Only if discovery from the Fluxer address fails: the API base including /v1. Overrides the Fluxer address.

Config.Name: YouTube poll interval
Config.Description: Seconds between YouTube checks. Blank = 300, minimum 60.

Config.Name: Twitch poll interval
Config.Description: Seconds between Twitch checks. Blank = 120, minimum 30.

Config.Name: yt-dlp path
Config.Description: Use this yt-dlp instead of the copy botsu downloads into the data folder and updates daily. Blank = botsu's own copy.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Log filter. Blank = info,botsu=debug. Use info for less output.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the bot runs as (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the bot runs as (Unraid default: 100 = users).
